viz_p12.title: JVM Heap Memory Usage vs Max (GB)

options.query:
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="connect"  BY pod span=1m
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval pod_series=series."-".pod
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by pod_series

| mstats avg(_value) as used WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="connect"  BY pod span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by pod
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)
| fields - used capacity pod

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="connect"
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by pod
| eval value=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0 AND value>=prev_value, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="connect"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval pod_series=series."-".pod
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by pod_series

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by pod
| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0 AND value>=prev_value, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="connect"  BY pod span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by pod
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)
| fields - used capacity pod

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0 AND value>=prev_value, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| stats latest(rate) as value
| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="connect"

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval instance_series=series."-".'service.instance.id'
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by instance_series

| mstats avg(_value) as used WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by service.instance.id
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)
| fields - used capacity service.instance.id

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"
| eval value=value/1024/1024/1024

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by service.instance.id
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0 AND value>=prev_value, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time)*100, null())
| timechart span=1m avg(rate) by service.instance.id

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_threads_current" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-connect" service.instance.id="$pod$"

title: Confluent Kafka Connect Resources (Memory, CPU, JVM)
description: Per-pod container resource usage (memory/CPU vs Kubernetes limits, as gauges + GB/core-scaled values) and JVM heap/GC/thread metrics for Kafka Connect worker pods (defaults to pod=connect-*) in the confluent namespace.
